adds.title: Public Religion Research Institute (PRRI) polls and Louisiana's Equality Profile - via Movement Advancement Project
adds.summary: As of October 12, 2026 Louisiana has a Negative gender-identity policy score of -8.75/25 and overall score of -8.75/47 with no state gender-identity nondiscrimination laws for employment, housing, or public accommodations, leaving only federal EEOC and court recourse for employment discrimination under the June 2020 U.S. Supreme Court ruling.

adds.title: Maine anti-discrimination law - 2005 amendment
adds.summary: Maine amended the Maine Human Rights Act, 5 M.R.S. §4551 et seq., by PL 2005, c. 10 (LD 1196) to extend civil-rights protections regardless of sexual orientation as part of the sexual-orientation-and-gender-identity protection effort, following repeal of the 1997 protections (PL 1997, c. 205) in the February 10, 1998 people's veto and defeat of the 1999 protections (PL 1999, c. 629) in the November 7, 2000 referendum, and the 2005 protections survived the November 8, 2005 people's veto referendum.
